transcript:
Speaker A (Delivery Boy): Why are you not answering my phone? I have been standing at your location with your courier for last 30 minutes. Please come immediately and collect it. I can't keep waiting any longer.
Speaker B (Woman): Aati hu aati hu. [Coming, coming.] Are bhaiya, aapka gussa dekhkar to mai dar hi gayi thi. Aur haan, wo bhi itni fluent English me! Kaise bol lete ho itni acchi English? [Oh brother, I got scared seeing your anger. And that too in such fluent English! How do you speak such good English?]
Speaker A: Mam, jabse English me bolna seekha hai na, tabse mujhe jab bhi customer pe gussa aata hai, to mai uspar English me hi chilla deta hu. Customer bhi sochne lagta hai ki koi bahut bada officer aaya hai delivery karne. Haan haan, aapko to pata hi hai ki aajkal English bolne walo ki hi izzat hoti hai. [Ma'am, ever since I learned to speak English, whenever I get angry at a customer, I shout at them in English. The customer also starts thinking that some big officer has come to deliver. Yes, yes, you know that nowadays only English speakers get respect.]
Speaker B: Lekin ye batao, tumne itni acchi English bolna seekhi kaha se? English Seekho app? Mai kuch samjhi nahi. [But tell me, where did you learn to speak such good English? English Seekho app? I didn't understand.]
Speaker A: English Seekho app spoken English ki best app hai. Jahan experts ekdum basic level se English samajhna aur bolna sikhate hain. Aur iske AI coach ka to kehna hi kya! 24*7 available rehta hai English me baat karne ki practice karane ke liye. Maine English Seekho app ke AI coach aur expert ki madad se hi English bolna seekha hai. Baaki ye lijiye aapka courier, mujhe bahut late ho raha hai. Ab aap log mujhe kya dekh rahe hain? Jao English Seekho app download karo aur English bolna seekh jao! [English Seekho app is the best app for spoken English. Where experts teach understanding and speaking English from the very basic level. And what to say about its AI coach! It remains available 24/7 to practice speaking in English. I learned to speak English with the help of English Seekho app's AI coach and experts. Anyway, here is your courier, I am getting very late. Now what are you guys looking at me for? Go download the English Seekho app and learn to speak English!]
Voiceover: To install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
English Seekho
INSTALL NOW
[Disclaimer text in Hindi]
summary: A delivery driver impresses a customer by speaking fluent English, explaining that it commands respect. He attributes his skills to the English Seekho app's AI coach and expert lessons, urging viewers to download the app.
